name: Rainy Window
description: Persistent rain, wetness, rivulet flow, and glass thickness with exact C loads, a bounded sprung hand wiper, held clearing, click splashes, three-band glints, physical absorption, ACES, and semantic alpha.

updatedParams.name: Rain Intensity
updatedParams.description: Bead density on the scrolling lattice conveyor; bass adds up to +80%. The cell hash keys on position only, never on time.

updatedParams.name: Wiper Size
updatedParams.description: Blade half-width for both the hand wiper and the autonomous sweep; also sets the sweep rate.

updatedParams.name: Distortion
updatedParams.description: Refraction offset through the water film.

updatedParams.name: Drying Speed
updatedParams.description: Evaporation rate of the water film.

name: Ink Marbling
description: Persistent pigment and thickness marbling with exact-load advection and neighbor diffusion, three-band plasma turbulence, sprung held stirring, bounded click ink drops, ACES output, and semantic alpha.

name: Kimi Liquid Glass
description: Persistent liquid-glass height and thickness with exact C loads, held lens push, click waves, three-band caustics, chromatic Snell refraction, interference highlights, ACES, and semantic alpha.

name: Liquid Displacement
description: Persistent velocity and height-field image displacement with exact-load pressure projection, viscosity diffusion, bounded pointer velocity, held flow injection, click waves, three-band turbulence, caustics, ACES, and semantic alpha.

name: Liquid Fast
description: Low-viscosity analytical liquid with bounded pointer inertia, high-speed vortex wakes, dispersive click packets, exact-load temporal advection, three-band spectral caustics, ACES, and semantic alpha.

name: Liquid Glitch
description: Block-quantized liquid smearing with bounded pointer tear velocity, held vortex corruption, click shard bursts, three-band chromatic splitting, exact-load datamosh history, ACES, and semantic alpha.

params.name: Flow Corruption
params.description: Liquid smear and signal corruption intensity

name: Liquid Jelly
description: Spring-damped jelly deformation with bounded pointer inertia, exact-load thickness slopes, soft recovery, subsurface scattering, three-band audio, click waves, ACES output, and semantic alpha.

updatedParams.name: Damping
updatedParams.description: Damping of the jelly's shear oscillation; also sets the pointer-spring recovery.

updatedParams.name: Elasticity
updatedParams.description: Shear modulus G; sets the finite wave speed c = sqrt(G/rho) at which click wobbles propagate outward.

updatedParams.name: Wobble Strength
updatedParams.description: Displacement amplitude of the shear wave and the length of the jiggle overshoot streaks.

updatedParams.name: Scatter Tint
updatedParams.description: Hue offset into the candy palette that replaced the warm/cool two-tone lerp.

name: Liquid Metal
description: A persistent ferro-metal simulation whose raw A state packs height, velocity, foam, and wetness, with a bass-driven hexagonal Rosensweig spike mode, held magnetic pole, click impulses, chromatic refraction, and Ward-style anisotropic metallic reflection.

name: Liquid Mirror
description: A persistent reflective height field with bounded sprung pointer push, held dents, click waves, exact C state, three-band steel highlights, Fresnel reflection, ACES, and semantic alpha.

name: Liquid Oil
description: A persistent high-viscosity thin-film simulation packing height, response, shear, and coverage in A, with slow capillary flow, pointer stirring, click waves, interference color, specular oil optics, exact C loads, ACES, and semantic alpha.

name: Liquid Optimized (Pass 1)
description: Physics simulation pass: capillary wave dynamics, Laplace pressure, ripple propagation, and ambient micro-ripples. Outputs height field state to dataTextureA.

name: Liquid Surface Tension (Optimized)
description: Capillary surface tension with an ANALYTIC height gradient: the field is evaluated once and its exact derivative accumulated in the same loop, replacing five full evaluations (up to 250 ripple iterations per pixel) with one. The saved budget buys an eight-train FFT capillary spectrum with dispersion-correct phase speeds and Fresnel-weighted Beer-Lambert absorption along the true slant path.

updatedParams.name: Surface Tension
updatedParams.description: Height scale and refraction strength of the film.

updatedParams.name: Gravity Scale
updatedParams.description: Wavenumber and phase speed of the click ripple packets.

updatedParams.name: Damping
updatedParams.description: Ripple packet amplitude retention.

updatedParams.name: Turbidity
updatedParams.description: Absorption path multiplier; also dulls the specular.

name: Liquid (Pass 1)
description: Capillary wave physics pass: surface tension simulation with Laplacian and biharmonic operators, gravity waves, ripple sources, and ambient micro-ripples. Outputs persistent height field to dataTextureA.

name: Liquid Perspective
description: A perspective-compressed three-wave Gerstner sheet with a depth-aware parallax Jacobian, silhouette-safe refraction, secondary shear flow, and bioluminescent click crests.

params.name: Density
params.description: Spatial frequency of the perspective flow

feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded parallax history loads

name: Liquid Rainbow Prismatic
description: Cauchy-separated RGB refraction through animated thin-film thickness, a six-tap caustic kernel, held lens deformation, and prismatic click fronts.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded refractive history loads

name: Liquid Rainbow
description: Thin-film liquid refraction with bounded pointer inertia, held vortex shear, dispersive click crests, exact-load trails, Fresnel interference, three-band chromatic separation, ACES, and semantic alpha.

params.name: Viscosity
params.description: Flow damping and spectral film thickness

name: Liquid RGB
description: Independently advected wavelength channels curl through vortex-flow dispersion, Beer–Lambert absorption, chromatic caustic seams, and held or click-driven shear.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded wavelength-flow history loads

name: Liquid Smear
description: Pigment drag along the pointer's real travel direction, taken from a spring-damped cursor and its velocity in extraBuffer[133..136] — the previous version always pulled toward the cursor centre, which reads as a sink rather than a brush. A five-tap kernel bleeds pigment along the stroke normal with a width set by the local FFT bin. History is fetched with exact textureLoad, bilinear by hand.

updatedParams.name: Smear Strength
updatedParams.description: Drag length along the pointer stroke.

updatedParams.name: Brush Size
updatedParams.description: Radius of the drag falloff around the cursor.

updatedParams.name: Persistence
updatedParams.description: How much of the smeared field survives each frame.

updatedParams.name: Mix Strength
updatedParams.description: Blend of the smeared field over the live plate.

name: Liquid Tensor Vortex
description: Source-luma structure-tensor eigenflow advects liquid metal through curl vortices, coherent folds, held-pointer torque, and click-launched metallic fronts.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded tensor-flow loads

name: Liquid (Ambient)
description: A clean baseline persistent liquid height field with ambient capillary modes, held pointer push, click waves, exact C state, three-band caustics, ACES output, and semantic alpha.

name: Liquid Viscous Nebula grokcf1
description: Cosmic viscous flow with bounded heavy pointer inertia, held vortex shear, long-lived click eddies, exact-load nebula trails, three-band emissive veins, ACES, and semantic alpha.

name: Liquid Viscous (Simple)
description: An efficient laminar streamline field with a lightweight cohesion stencil, shear-thinning response, spectral surface sheen, and held or click-driven vortices.
feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded laminar history loads

name: Liquid Viscous
description: 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes with vorticity confinement. Vorticity at the centre and its four neighbours now comes from ONE shared stencil (was five separate calls, each doing four filtered samples), the pressure solve genuinely relaxes instead of recomputing one value four times, and the audio vortices drift along continuous Lissajous paths instead of teleporting every 0.7 s. Dye is injected per FFT band. dataTextureA carries simulation state.

updatedParams.name: Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Velocity damping and dye dissipation rate.

updatedParams.name: Vorticity Confinement
updatedParams.description: Strength of the confinement force that keeps eddies from smearing out (maps to zoom_params.y).

updatedParams.name: Turbulence Injection
updatedParams.description: Gain on the three-octave cascade and the per-band dye emitters (maps to zoom_params.z).

updatedParams.name: Hue Shift
updatedParams.description: Rotates the dye/vorticity hue mapping (maps to zoom_params.w).

name: Liquid Zoom
description: Endless zoom-through built from four phase-offset parallax layers composited back-to-front by scene depth, each owning two FFT bins so the stack pulses through the spectrum. Replaces the previous two-layer version whose depth write picked a dominant layer with a hard threshold that popped on every crossing. Clicks emit bounded zoom pulses.

updatedParams.name: Near Layer Speed
updatedParams.description: Zoom cadence for near (low-depth) pixels — maps to zoom_params.x.

updatedParams.name: Far Layer Speed
updatedParams.description: Zoom cadence for far (high-depth) pixels — maps to zoom_params.y.

updatedParams.name: Parallax Strength
updatedParams.description: Exponent shaping the depth-to-speed curve — maps to zoom_params.z.

updatedParams.name: Fog Density
updatedParams.description: Distance fog applied to far layers — maps to zoom_params.w.

feedbackPacking: A/C = final tone-mapped display RGBA; exact bounded melt-history loads

Luma Velocity Melt
